input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and approaches the walk-away position of an exclusive foreign venue. It also directly conflicts with § 28.2, which grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. The minimal fix replaces only the jurisdiction and forum words in 28.1 with New York law and New York County courts, reaching the preferred position and harmonizing the two clauses. No arbitration provision exists elsewhere in the document.

ops.oldText: Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law and forum in 28.1 from Singapore to New York law and the state and federal courts in New York County, consistent with our standard position and with the venue already agreed in 28.2 (which 28.1 currently contradicts). If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts, or the laws of England and Wales with the courts of London.
proposal.summary: Replace Singapore law/courts in 28.1 with New York law and New York County courts.
